sections.text:
Process
Processes that were created with good
intentions but do not lead to productivity are
largely inward looking, have multiple layers of
approvals and complexity.
Culture
The way things, people, processes, and
communication have been in the organisation.
Technology
Technology which was intended to make things
faster and easier but hinders outcomes, has a
large learning curve or lacks support.
Capability
The level of skills, knowledge and
motivation that an organisation imparts
to its people on a continual basis.
Friction across 4 dimensions
creates Sludge:

sections.text:
6 Reasons To De-Sludge
The effort that employees have
to put in to accomplish tasks
with levels of approvals,
complex processes and
regulations overwhelm them.
Hinders productivity
Misaligned KPIs and too much
red tape act as barriers to
acting in the best interest of
the company.
Holds Back
Empowerment
Unaligned goals and unsaid
expectations of teams make it
difficult for them to collaborate.
Blocks Collaboration
Sludge means time and
money wasted on inefficient
or obsolete processes.
Creates Waste
Employees disengage
when processes and
regulations are too painful.
Causes Attrition
Employees find it difficult to do
what’s best for customers when
internal sludge hinders their
creativity and empowerment.
Impedes Customer
Centric Culture
